entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Obsolete the Response Caching middleware APIs #70889

  • Address IL3000 warning from Assembly.Location in Blazor WebView for single-file and Native AOT #70878

Closed
